settlementFee.note: Genuine escrow/settlement fee schedule (not premium-only) -- tiered by sales price for a residential purchase and sale transaction.

International lender refinance escrow fee (up to $1,000,000)

bundlingNotes: Explicitly a genuine escrow/settlement fee schedule, not a title-premium-only manual -- rare among this survey's sources. Fees described as 'minimum fees for basic escrow services ordinarily rendered in a residential purchase and sale transaction'; commercial/developer transactions quoted separately. Hawaii general excise tax (GET) added to all escrow charges. Title Guaranty is described as 'Hawaii's largest escrow company' with 17 statewide branch locations, established 1955 (escrow arm) / 1896 (title arm) -- likely the dominant provider in this market.
transactionContext: Residential purchase and sale escrow fees, statewide (no separate island/metro tiers published, though the company has branches on Oahu, Maui, Big Island, and Kauai), plus refinance, FIRPTA/HARPTA, tax-deferred exchange, and holding-escrow special fees.

provider: Title Guaranty of Hawaii, LLC (title insurance side)

settlementFee.note: Title insurance premium schedule (companion document to the escrow fee schedule above, same provider).
settlementFee.altaHomeownersOrExpandedLoanPolicy: 110% of Hawaii Standard Owner's Policy premium
settlementFee.altaExtendedOwnersPolicy: 150% of Hawaii Standard Owner's Policy premium

bundlingNotes: Buyer pays 40% / seller pays 60% of the title premium by Hawaii custom -- an unusually explicit split published directly on the rate card rather than left to negotiation, found nowhere else in this survey to date. Title insurance premium credits of up to 50% (prior policy within 12 months) or 25% (within 8 years) are available; a 30% Military Credit applies to active-duty/retired service members' primary residence transactions.
transactionContext: Owner's/ALTA Loan Policy premium schedule with explicit 60/40 seller/buyer split, statewide, plus Junior Loan, Litigation Guarantee, Certificate of Title, and various report products. Agent for Chicago Title, Commonwealth Land Title, Fidelity National Title, and First American Title Insurance Company underwriters.

provider: First American Title Insurance Company (Hawaii branches)

settlementFee.note: Combined title premium AND escrow fee schedule, tiered by insurance amount ($100,000 to $5,000,000 in the full table).
settlementFee.escrowFee50PercentEachParty: Half of the above full-tier fee, e.g. $305 at $100,000; $1,243 at $1,000,000
settlementFee.eaglePolicy: 10% additional premium over Extended Owner's Policy, paid by purchaser
settlementFee.reverseMortgageOneRateEscrowFee: $500.00 flat (includes customary escrow services, mailing up to $25, courier up to $25, two wire fees, tax search, one e-delivery, lien/financing statement search on two borrowers; excludes title premium, endorsements, recording, transfer tax, notary, loan signing)

bundlingNotes: The only source in this survey found to publish title premium AND escrow fee side-by-side across a full price-tier table with 50+ rows (vs. Title Guaranty's two separate documents for the same information). Same 60%/40% seller/buyer premium split convention as Title Guaranty, but escrow fee is split 50/50. Multiple special discount rates (Investor's, Senior Citizen, U.S. Armed Forces, First-Time Homebuyer, Government Employee, each 25% off Title Fee) are unusually generous and numerous compared to other states surveyed. Document is from 2013 -- the oldest-vintage source in this HI file -- so dollar figures likely understate 2026 pricing, but the escrow-fee-to-premium ratio pattern remains a useful structural reference.
transactionContext: Residential resale (purchase) and refinance escrow + title premium schedules for improved 1-4 family residential property, Oahu/Maui/Hilo/Kona branches (statewide via 9 branch locations), no separate metro/island pricing tiers.

provider: Old Republic Title Insurance Company — Estimated Rate/Fee Calculator (ortconline.com)
scenario: $500,000 purchase price / $400,000 loan amount, residential resale, Sale transaction type, Loan Estimate calculation. Property location: Honolulu, HI (Honolulu County/Oahu, HI's most populous county).
methodology: Harvested via direct HTTP GET/POST against the calculator's ASP.NET WebForms postback mechanism (__VIEWSTATE/__EVENTVALIDATION), replicating the sequential form submissions the browser's JS performs (state select -> city select, which auto-populated the EscrowCountyComboList to 'Honolulu' -> Sales Price/Loan Amount/Lien Payoff=0 -> Submit); no browser/JS execution was used or required. The 'Your Name', 'Your Company', and 'This estimate is being prepared for' fields were left blank throughout -- confirmed optional -- no fabricated personal information was entered at any step.

settlementFee.note: Not a single line item in this tool's output; the closest analog is the 'Settlement Agent Fee' shown in Section C, split buyer/seller (buyer's share shown here). Settlement Agent Fee total (both parties): Title - Settlement Agent Fee (Total: $2,252.36).

itemizedFees.processing: $1,126.18 (Settlement Agent Fee, buyer's share; Total both parties: $2,252.36)

bundlingNotes: Selecting City=Honolulu auto-selected EscrowCountyComboList=Honolulu (Oahu is coextensive with Honolulu County, no zip disambiguation needed, unlike MO's Kansas City). Owner's Title Policy* (Total: $836.00) calculated from full Homeowner's Policy rate of $2,321... consistent with the tool's standard cross-state disclosure language (same wording pattern as OH/AZ/NV/NM/UT/MO harvests) that this total reflects the full Homeowner's Policy rate plus a concurrent lender's-issue charge, less the full lender's policy premium. This is the first HI-specific Old Republic figure in this survey; HI.json's existing sources (Title Guaranty, First American, Old Republic Title & Escrow's own manual) are all published-schedule (basis 'published'), so this calculator harvest is a genuine independent cross-check, not a duplicate.
transactionContext: Calculator-derived point estimate for the standard $500k/$400k purchase scenario; property location Honolulu, HI (Honolulu County/Oahu, HI's most populous county).
